pending_selection.hook_sentence: Cut this file off anywhere you like and it still opens — as a shorter version of the same document.
pending_selection.one_line: A document written into one HTML file in importance order, laid back out in reading order by CSS, so that every byte-prefix of the file is itself a coherent, shorter document.

blocking_questions: Accessibility: CSS order divorces visual order from DOM order, so assistive technology follows importance order rather than reading order. Must be measured in a real browser and answered, mitigated, or accepted in writing.
Empirical: does a truncation landing inside a tag or attribute break the block containing it, in Chromium? Test before designing.
Scope: format-first (container plus decoder) or HTML-first (no decoder)? Milestone 1 should be HTML-first, because it fails fastest.
Prior art: the search done on 2026-09-17 is recorded in IDEAS.md and is explicitly not sufficient for a NOVELTY_REPORT. Complete it across the Section 6 ecosystems before selecting.

Calibration: REFERENCES.md asks whether the idea is in that company. It has the jq and Mother-of-all-Demos properties and lacks the Corridor one — it is not a pain felt daily by its builder. Push on that.
